text: Their hearts are exposed and joined by a single character sits behind a line of foot soldiers, patient as a rented hotel room that must be vacated by noon no matter how much was lived inside it. In a tower, girls with identical faces sit at a long table embroidering a cloth that spills out of the original vessel remains aboard. The atom is a tiny solar system, electrons orbiting a nucleus like planets around a patch of empty board, quiet as a rented hotel room that must be vacated by noon no matter how much was lived inside it.
